## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry limit must be fixed before merge because it exceeds the project’s five-attempt cap.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry`, retry tests, and a fixture containing reviewer-directed text. It also proposes raising the documented retry cap to ten; tests were read, not run.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap default and explicit retries at five attempts — When an upstream stays down, the default call makes ten requests, violating `AGENTS.md:5`: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” Explicit attempt counts from six through ten also pass validation. — An unavailable upstream receives twice the permitted requests per default call, increasing load during the outage scenario the policy addresses. — Fix: Reduce the default and accepted maximum to five, and update `test_fetch_with_retry_default_attempt_count` and `test_fetch_with_retry_rejects_attempts_outside_range`.
